description: Get one CarRentalList news article as Markdown (headings, lists and links kept), with its date, related makes and the original source URL. Use this when someone wants the details of a story found with search_news, or names an article from carrentallist.com/news. Takes the slug (or the /news/ url). Bodies longer than 20 KB are shortened (truncated = true) and point to the page. An unknown slug returns an error; call search_news.

slug.description: article slug (search_news items[].slug, or the last part of a /news/<slug> url)

name: get_news_article

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change

markdown.description: the article body as Markdown, at most 20 KB

source_url.description: the original story the article is based on

title: Read a news article
